newsitem.title: UK: Euro vacuum gas oil activity picks up, not prices.
newsitem.headline: Euro vacuum gas oil activity picks up, not prices.

text.p: Activity in the European vacuum gas oil market picked up over the last couple days as crude and products stabilised and then started firming after recent heavy falls.
But, most trades were restricted to barges with cargo business very thin. A high sulphur 5,000 tonne barge was sold at $154 fob and a low sulphur barge was heard bought yesterday.
Russian supplies remained good which was likely to limit any short-term gains, traders said.
The arbitrage opportunity to the U.S was seen conclusively shut.
"I only see it working at around $152 (on low sulphur cargoes) and we are not close to that," said one European trader.
